name: Kapalabhati
stop_prompts: Stop if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.
Stop if you feel tingling or numbness in your hands or face.
Stop if your chest feels tight.
Stop if your vision changes or blurs.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Kapalabhati is in the library for reference. It cannot be guided in this app.
copy.end: If you want to learn it, look for a qualified, in-person teacher.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Excluded from the default library: forceful hyperventilation. Research gives no timing, so there is no playable pacing and it is unavailable until a timing source is reviewed.
